summary: Recipya is a self-hosted recipe manager designed for households. It provides a centralised space to store, organise, and consult culinary instructions and meal ideas.
goodFor: It suits families or individuals looking for a dedicated, local-first system to manage their personal recipe collections away from commercial platforms.
watchOut: The project relies on a relatively modest community and maintenance pace, meaning you might encounter slower response times for bug fixes or feature requests compared to more mature alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for your recipe data and configuration, alongside a reverse proxy if you require TLS termination.
